newsitem.title: UK: Kingfisher declines comment on BUT report.
newsitem.headline: Kingfisher declines comment on BUT report.

text.p: British retailer Kingfisher Plc said on Thursday it could make no comment on a report that it was contemplating a bid for French furniture and electricals retailer BUT in which it has a 26 percent stake.
A company spokesman said the firm did not comment on what it said was speculation.
The Financial Times newspaper suggested Kingfisher was planning to mount a takeover offer, which it estimated could cost up to 300 million stg.

The retailer bought the stake in France's second biggest furniture chain and fourth largest electricals group last year for 59 million stg. Under the deal the retailer is obliged to wait until 1998 before making any offer.
Earlier BUT denied that Kingfisher was planning a takeover.
